notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Mostly white plates with a touch of red on the left from a national symbol.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Cyrillic script with the letters Ɵ and Ү, which Russian lacks; double vowels like aa and ЭЭ are common.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Coverage was shot from a large pickup truck, usually visible, often with a roof tent, red mirrors, snorkel or roof racks.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Vast treeless steppe and desert grassland, with rocky or rolling hills, rivers and lakes.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: White bowling-pin shaped bollards with two red stripes around the top, unique here.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Wooden poles propped by stone blocks, white lamp posts and three-striped pedestrian crossing signs show clear Russian influence.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: The stop sign reads ЗОГС, unique to this country.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Neighbourhoods are split by dirt alleys and wooden fences.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: White round yurts, the traditional nomad home, appear across the country, with big yurt districts in the capital's hilly suburbs.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Large herds of horses, yaks, cows, sheep, goats and camels are common.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Decorated stone piles called ovoos serve as shrines and markers.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Coverage is limited, mostly highways and large towns, densest around the capital; driving direction usually points away from it.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Very flat in the east and south, rolling hills in the north, big mountains and rocky hills in the west.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Forests of Siberian larch with pines and birch, ringed by grassy fields, across the north.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Small dirt tracks through vast flat grass fields in the far east.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Desert off-road coverage and paved desert roads in the south; dry brown soil and flatness along the long border highway.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Dry rugged mountains and many lakes and rivers in the far west.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: The capital holds about half the population: high-rises, chain stores, clean roads and vast yurt districts.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Roof tent colour and style splits the country: light blue in the east, silver in the central northwest, grey with hooks in the west.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The spare tyre style (netted, strap, none) and rubber roof-rack inlays help split west from east.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Bright orange sand dunes in a southern national park.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Remote far-west coverage of the tallest peaks with glaciers and snow caps.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Four areas have night coverage, all driven toward a town.
